description: Highlight files and lines relative to a fixed Git commit without changing Git state.
command.selectBaselineForAll: Git Baseline Highlights: Set Base for All Repositories
command.selectBaselineForRepository: Git Baseline Highlights: Select Repository Baseline
config.repository: Optional repository directory, absolute or relative to the active workspace folder. Empty automatically discovers the active Git repository.
config.base: Optional commit, tag, or branch. Changing this value resolves and freezes the commit; refresh does not follow moving references. Leave empty to select a baseline using the command.
config.comparisonMode: How to resolve a branch or tag baseline.
config.comparisonMode.direct: Compare directly against the selected commit.
config.comparisonMode.mergeBase: Compare against the merge base of the selected ref and HEAD, like a pull-request review.
config.followBase: Re-resolve a configured branch or tag on every refresh instead of freezing its first resolved commit.
config.scanDepth: Maximum directory depth for discovering nested Git repositories. 0 only checks workspace roots.
config.showGutterIcons: Show baseline gutter icons. Disabled by default to keep Git gutter marks clear.
config.showOverviewRuler: Show baseline marks in the overview ruler. Disabled by default to keep Git marks clear.
config.showFileBadges: Show A/M/D/R baseline file badges and changed-folder markers. Disabled by default to keep Git file badges clear.
